_comment: Vanilla ships potion.potency.0 through .5 only, because no vanilla source produces an amplifier above 5. Phoenix Chambered Heart grants amplifier 9 (level X), which would otherwise render as the raw key. Lang files from every namespace are merged into one map, so defining a minecraft: key here is the supported fix.
_comment_tremor: Earthquake ships its own damage type entropymod:tremor (see EntropyDamageTypes), so it needs its own death message key. message_id 'tremor' -> death.attack.tremor.
death.attack.tremor: %1$s was shaken apart by the earth
